feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is stated for it. Evidence: in all three earlier races (iterations 0 to 2) every one of 180 trials ended off track, with progress between 0.10 and 0.16 and max_error 0.061 to 0.067 m. Progress was nearly identical across designs. The s-bend stayed at about 0.15 and the slalom at about 0.105 whether base_speed was 1.6, 1.4 or 1.2, and whether kp was 4.0 or 3.5. Sensor changes (iteration 1 and iteration 2) did not move it either. This points to a drift that none of the levers tried so far has addressed. The current candidate is the first to change kp substantially (4.0 to 2.5), and it pairs that with ki 0.2 and base_speed 1.0, so it tests a different regime. The geometry is unchanged from iteration 1 except for sensor_size 0.012, so it is a clean controller test. It cannot finish the course in 3 s at base_speed 1.0, so judge it on progress and max_error. Approve it for telemetry. It is valid, early in the race, and the earlier variants share a failure that this one tests directly. Read the race as follows. If progress rises well above 0.2 or the run survives longer on the s-bend and slalom, keep kp near 2.5 and raise base_speed in steps (1.2, then 1.4). If progress stays near 0.1 to 0.15 with low steering_oscillation, the gain is not the limit, so raise ki toward 0.5 to correct the fixed left/right mismatch. If steering_oscillation is high (0.14 or more), raise kd toward 0.4 before changing kp again.
requested_changes: After race 3: if progress rises clearly above 0.2 on the s-bend and slalom with max_error below 0.06, keep kp near 2.5 and raise controller.base_speed in steps (1.0 to 1.2 to 1.4) to reach completion_time under 3 s.

After race 3: if progress stays near 0.10 to 0.15 with steering_oscillation below 0.10, the gain is not the limit. Raise controller.ki from 0.2 toward 0.5 to cancel the fixed motor mismatch, keeping kp 2.5.

After race 3: if steering_oscillation is 0.14 or higher on any track, raise controller.kd from 0.3 to about 0.4 before changing kp or base_speed, since iteration 1 showed kd 0.3 reduced oval oscillation.
